name: deliver
description: One-implementer delivery loop: plan, implement, independent review, supported fixes, and final verification.

chain.label: Plan the change
chain.task:
Create an implementation-ready plan for: {task}

Inspect repository instructions and the governing source, callers, tests, and configuration. Scope and refine searches when results are broad or truncated. If the request references a pi-workbench-feature-ledger, open it and its Spec baseline first, verify the stable task or milestone ID, and plan only that one ready task or coherent current milestone against its named acceptance criteria; report blocked or inconsistent state instead of consuming the backlog. Classify the work as a feature, bug, refactor, or mechanical change and scale the method accordingly. For a bug, identify expected versus observed behavior and the causal seam or name the missing reproduction evidence. For a refactor, state behavior and compatibility invariants. Define the smallest coherent change, explicit non-goals, global constraints, affected interfaces and paths, risks, cleanup behavior, required ledger updates, and exact validation. Prewalk the plan through real consumers or dispatchers and owning tests; remove unnecessary files, duplicate steps, and contradictions. Choose a focused failing regression or contract test when it has real evidence value; otherwise specify characterization coverage or the strongest relevant non-test validation. Do not edit files. Return a compact Markdown plan and proportional handoff.

Tests, simplicity, and applicable security review
